raw: [name="Eblana"]Of course. Why would I blame you for that?
speaker: Eblana
content: Of course. Why would I blame you for that?

speaker: 'The Bureaucrat'
content: O-Oh, alright then.

raw: [name="'The Bureaucrat'"]By the way, about the sacred instruments I reported to you about...
speaker: 'The Bureaucrat'
content: By the way, about the sacred instruments I reported to you about...

speaker: Eblana
content: A trifling matter.

raw: [name="Eblana"]What is truly important is that my faithful servants be rewarded for this victory.
speaker: Eblana
content: What is truly important is that my faithful servants be rewarded for this victory.

raw: Eblana picks up the beetle from the ground and flattens her palm. The beetle buzzes as it flies toward the door.
content: Eblana picks up the beetle from the ground and flattens her palm. The beetle buzzes as it flies toward the door.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Ladies and gentlemen, we are in the very hall where the treasures of the ancient King Gaeil were once displayed.
speaker: Eblana
content: Ladies and gentlemen, we are in the very hall where the treasures of the ancient King Gaeil were once displayed.

raw: [name="Eblana"]The furnishings had all been looted by the Victorians, as they are wont to do, but we have finally returned most of them to their rightful places.
speaker: Eblana
content: The furnishings had all been looted by the Victorians, as they are wont to do, but we have finally returned most of them to their rightful places.

raw: [name="Eblana"]That beetle you were chasing was awarded personally to a capable official. He was praised for his tireless work in gathering ever last grain of the harvest and storing it in the treasury.
speaker: Eblana
content: That beetle you were chasing was awarded personally to a capable official. He was praised for his tireless work in gathering ever last grain of the harvest and storing it in the treasury.

raw: [name="Eblana"]And now, you are worthy of the same. Without you, our army would likely have collapsed from hunger a hundred times over.
speaker: Eblana
content: And now, you are worthy of the same. Without you, our army would likely have collapsed from hunger a hundred times over.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Go chase it down, for it is yours. As long as it is willing to land on you, you will always have the right to collect our grain.
speaker: Eblana
content: Go chase it down, for it is yours. As long as it is willing to land on you, you will always have the right to collect our grain.

speaker: 'The Bureaucrat'
content: Yes... Thank you!

speaker: Eblana
content: Now then...
Eblana scans the room.

raw: Some stare intently at The Bureaucrat's back, wondering what rewards they will receive, while others cannot help but glance at the other treasures in the room.
content: Some stare intently at The Bureaucrat's back, wondering what rewards they will receive, while others cannot help but glance at the other treasures in the room.

raw: The sword that enforces the law, the cloudbeast that listens to appeals, the knot that records history, the crystal teardrops that symbolize compassion...
content: The sword that enforces the law, the cloudbeast that listens to appeals, the knot that records history, the crystal teardrops that symbolize compassion...

raw: [name="Eblana"]It seems none of you can stand to wait any longer.
speaker: Eblana
content: It seems none of you can stand to wait any longer.

raw: [name="Eblana"]How about this, then: everyone, feel free to take whatever in this room you desire.
speaker: Eblana
content: How about this, then: everyone, feel free to take whatever in this room you desire.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
In an instant, it is as if all the treasures come to life, moving on their own.
content: In an instant, it is as if all the treasures come to life, moving on their own.

raw: The cloudbeast statue starts running, the crystals start rolling, the knot begins to twist, and even the ceremonial sword studded with Sargonian jewels breaks free from its stand, hopping comically toward the door.
content: The cloudbeast statue starts running, the crystals start rolling, the knot begins to twist, and even the ceremonial sword studded with Sargonian jewels breaks free from its stand, hopping comically toward the door.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Go, my servants. These are my rewards for your loyalty.
speaker: Eblana
content: Go, my servants. These are my rewards for your loyalty.

raw: It is unclear who takes the first step, but once he does, the tide is unstoppable.
content: It is unclear who takes the first step, but once he does, the tide is unstoppable.

raw: The crowd chases after the treasures, surging out of the banquet hall.
content: The crowd chases after the treasures, surging out of the banquet hall.
